_readme: THE BOAT AT THE MERRIMACK'S ENTRANCE (2026-10-23, WATER_V2 12.12-12.13): the RHIB just seaward of the
ridge off the south jetty's tip -- the shoal the drawn sea used to sink over -- pointing in at the
entrance. The clocks are merrimack_bar.json's: the water at 2026-10-23T18:59:47Z (the scene's clock, the
data bound to it), the sun held at local noon on its own -- every run is the same sea, in daylight.
Launch from the repo root:  build/bin/gagame.exe scenes/demos/merrimack_boat.json
THE HELM (docs/VEHICLES.md): W / S both throttles ahead / astern, A / D the outboards, Q / E the levers
apart (a pivot), SHIFT / CTRL trim out / in. F frees the camera (the boat keeps the throttle and helm
it was given): W A S D fly, Q / E down / up, hold the right mouse button to look; F again returns to the
boat. T / Y take the next / previous form: the drone (recovery: flip the boat, T, fly, T back), the car.
